note: An empty budget list means no numerical targets have been established, never performance approval. Add sourced budgets with id, metric, unit, nonnegative ceiling limit (not a minimum FPS threshold), classification hard/target, source_ref, and optional asset_ids. Bind this file by path/hash from the processing family. Reports carry targets [{budget_id,value,unit}]. Preserve previous profiles and evidence when revising. No GPU/device performance is inferred from face counts.
